quarterly_data.signal: Credo's 10-Q: as of August 1, 2026 Credo had multiple manufacturing supply capacity reservation agreements with assembly subcontractors, making upfront deposits for reserved manufacturing capacity over terms of 2 to 6 years; refundable deposits were $88.4 million. After August 1, 2026 it entered an additional capacity reservation agreement with an assembly subcontractor and will pay $102.4 million of refundable deposits within fiscal 2027. Remaining performance obligations were approximately $4.2 million as of August 1, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: refundable capacity deposits $88.4 million (August 1, 2026); additional agreement with $102.4 million of deposits within fiscal 2027
